title: Hinomori Shizuku — Feels Like Magic〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good morning, Minori, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Have you checked our stream from yesterday? More people than usual have been watching it since it was archived.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I saw! I couldn't believe it either!
They must've really liked our little design competition.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Definitely. I have a feeling it's also because everyone's hoping to see us put on another show.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm still surprised that we ended up going with my design.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?! But your design was so good!
You even made individualized outfits for all of us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's right. I'm really looking forward to seeing how those outfits turn out.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Shizuku, you said that you want to get more input from our fans to make your design even more wonderful. Can you handle all that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. My goal is to keep refining what I already have while waiting for them to send us their thoughts.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Refine what you already have?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For instance, there are many different kinds of flowery lace that Airi chose for her design.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's why I think it's going to be important to choose the best material, and the best accessories and see if it all fits together through trial and error.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see.
In that case, you should keep picking away at it until you're satisfied.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much.
I promise to do everything I can to make this design even more wonderful than it already was.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Good! And if you ever need a hand, feel free to let us know!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. We have countless different fabrics, lace, buttons, accessories and other materials to choose from, so determining which is best won't be easy...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I appreciate your concern.
But I should be okay when it comes to those things.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know just the person to ask♪
A few days later
Sewing Lounge

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, Shizuku!
Sorry about the wait.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hello, Mizuki.
That's okay. Thank you so much for meeting me on such short notice.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's my pleasure! This is you we're talking about. I'll be there for you in a heartbeat if you ask♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, you want to talk about what materials to use for your stage outfits?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I'd like to take a look at as many options as I can and choose the ones that fit our needs best.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You mentioned before that you like doing collages, so I have a feeling you know quite a lot about these things.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Now I understand!
That explains why you asked me to show you a bunch of fabrics and materials.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Like you said, there's a lot. So many that I'd really rather have you look at images of some of them to get a better idea...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But first... Here!
I brought all the flowery lace stuff I could find at home!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They really come in all shapes and sizes. Fine doesn't even begin to describe how detailed some of these patterns are!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...!
I never knew that there were so many different patterns. This is incredible, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
We're just getting started.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
I brought some colored lace too♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's such a pretty color!
This color... It seems so bright and cheerful.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But this one has a much crisper color to it. Oh, this other one's gradated.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's like you're a professional having all this lace in your possession.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! Sometimes I really wonder if I could actually open my own store.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So, come one, come all!
I've got lots of cute stuff on offer!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for meeting with me today, Mizuki. I have a feeling my design's going to improve so much now because of you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You're very welcome!
I'm just glad that I was able to help, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, I really love how you guys are turning your design into actual outfits with the help of your fans.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it'll be the first time many of them are anything like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But we were able to put on an event in real life because of them, so I'm sure our outfits will turn out well if we really work together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Work together, huh?
That's really nice. It's so MMJ!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And as another MMJ fan, I'm really happy that I got a chance to help you like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You are? I'm glad you feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I promise to make sure that our outfits turn into something truly wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I want to exceed our fans' expectations, including you, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wah! Your smile's blinding!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Feel free to ask for any help if you ever need it! I want to give you all the support I can!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you! Your help means so much!
